descriptionChirho: A gentilic adjective (זַרְחִי) designating a member of the clan of Zerah, son of Judah (Num 26:13,20; Josh 7:17; 1 Chr 27:11,13). Used with the article (הַזַּרְחִי 'the Zerahite') and with prepositional prefix (לַזַּרְחִי 'of/to the Zerahite'). Multilingual evidence confirms a single referent: eng 'the Zerahite/Zarchite', spa 'el zerahíta/los zerajitas', hin 'ज़र्ही/जरही', arb 'الزَّرْحِيّ', kor '세라인', swa 'Wazera'. The prepositional prefix is a grammatical variation, not a distinct sense.
